scope: Read-only complete instruction-window inventory, not a recovered-source function count. Original boundaries inferred from dynamic symbols, ELF entry, actual relocations, direct-call targets and section start; indirect-only entries may be missing. Normalization masks only actual ELF relocation and direct-call immediates in memory; full relocation patterns and complete inferred-window lengths must match. No executable or normalized bytes are written. Raw equality reported separately. All relocated data consumption and transitive semantic equivalence remain unproven unless separately referenced evidence establishes a bounded case.
